ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($RecordType.DeveloperName = "KR_PSA"), OR( NOT(BEGINS(Name, "FY")), IF( OR((LOWER(RIGHT(Name, 3)) = "new"), (LOWER(RIGHT(Name, 5)) = "renew")), FALSE, TRUE ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Name does meet the formatting standard. Name for PSA must start with the fiscal year (FY) and end with either New or Renew. Format example: FY26-Account Name-City-NEW or FY26-Account Name-City-RENEW
